---
name: performance-benchmark
description: Design or run a reproducible, correctness-gated performance comparison.
---

Read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/coordination/PROJECT_STATUS.md`, `CURRENT_TASKS.md`, `AGENT_HANDOFF.md`, and `docs/benchmarks.md`. Confirm the assigned scope and inspect existing benchmark code before changing anything. Use deterministic inputs/seeds where appropriate, verify outputs before timing, record environment/backend/version, warmup and repetition methodology, and report raw observations with limitations. Do not print secrets, claim general speedups from one environment, add dependencies, or modify application code unless explicitly assigned. Record exact commands and results in the handoff.
